# Discussion Forum
Welcome to UIDAI Aadhaar Authentication discussion group. This group is created to facilitate Aadhaar Authentication related technical and integration discussions. By joining this group you automatically agree to the terms and conditions (user agreement) of this group mentioned below. All developer related content can be obtained at Aadhaar Developer Portal. Please request through Group home page for memberships

UIDAI does not guarantee the reliability, completeness,accuracy, timeliness or up-to-date-ness of the material presented on the Discussion Group. The material is published "as is", and does not represent the official views and opinions of UIDAI. Any reliance upon the Material presented on these forums shall be at User's own risk. UIDAI does not review the substance of the content posted by users on these forums and is therefore not responsible for any of such content. UIDAI is not responsible for the privacy practices of any user. All information that is disclosed in these areas becomes public information and users should exercise caution when deciding to share any of their personal information. However, UIDAI is authorized by you to remove or modify any data submitted by you to these forums for any reason we feel constitutes a violation of our policies, whether stated, implied or not. UIDAI has no control over the content and cannot ensure it will not be offensive or objectionable. We will, however, remove links to material that we feel is inappropriate as we become aware of them
Notice
by submitting the post(s) on the Discussion Group the participant grants UIDAI the copyright of the material submitted. Any solicited or non-solicited idea, suggestion, or comment that is mentioned in this discussion forum becomes the intellectual property of UIDAI and might end up in one of it's products or services without credit or monetary consideration given to the originator of the idea   
  
Conditions of Use
You are entirely responsible and liable for all postings, information and submissions made by you to this discussion group. You also agree that you will not post any copyrighted material that is not owned by yourself or the owners of these forums. In your use of the forum, you agree that you will not post any information which is unlawful, harmful, threatening, abusive, harassing, defamatory, vulgar, obscene, harassing, threatening, invading of others privacy, hateful, racially, ethnically or otherwise objectionable or violates any laws.
